Kannada actors Sri Murali, Prem, Rakshith Gowda and Sharan, and RJ Mayuraa Raghavendra (radio jockey) have chosen Neo Follicle Hair Transplant for hair restoration. Every patient gets the same doctor-led, private approach.

Hair loss is often a medical problem before a cosmetic one. The doctor finds the cause first and then recommends a transplant, a non-surgical treatment, or a combination. The aim is an honest plan and a result that still looks natural in ten years.

Doctor-led consultations (you are assessed by the doctor, not a counsellor), personalised treatment planning, transplant and non-surgical options under one roof, and a convenient Marathahalli location.

1. Consultation and scalp evaluation. 2. AI-driven TricoScan imaging of hair density. 3. Diagnosis and treatment plan (cause, transplant or treatment, graft count, expected result). 4. Hairline design. 5. Graft extraction and implantation. 6. Recovery and follow-up.
Scalp examination, donor area assessment, hair density evaluation and long-term planning. The treatment plan and cost are discussed after this.

FUE, DHI and NFT implanter hair transplants for the hairline, crown, beard, eyebrows and corrective cases; Unshaven U-FUE with no visible shaving; body hair transplant when scalp donor hair is limited. The technique is chosen at consultation.
Hair transplant pricing is graft-based: Rs 60 to Rs 100 per graft. A 2,000-graft procedure is roughly Rs 1,20,000 to Rs 2,00,000. The final cost is shared after your scalp evaluation.
EMI options are available, with no hidden charges.
Transplant cost depends on the number of grafts, baldness grade, donor quality, procedure type, doctor expertise and clinic standards.

There is no published price for PRP, GFC, QR678, exosome, Dutexome or stem cell therapy. The cost depends on the number of sessions and your hair loss stage, and is agreed at consultation before treatment starts.

qa.q: Does every hair loss patient need a transplant?
qa.v:
do i need surgery
is transplant necessary
qa.a: No. Early thinning, active hair fall, dandruff-related fall and alopecia often respond to non-surgical treatment such as GFC, PRP or QR678. A transplant is advised only when follicles are permanently lost. The doctor decides this at your consultation.

qa.q: Are the results permanent and natural?
qa.v:
is transplant permanent
will it look natural
results last
qa.a: Transplanted follicles come from permanent donor zones and continue to grow for life. Results are designed to blend with your natural hair, with new growth appearing gradually over 3 to 12 months. Results vary by case.

qa.q: When will I see results after a hair transplant?
qa.v:
how long for results
result timeline
when will hair grow
qa.a: Healing starts in the first week, temporary shedding is normal in weeks 2 to 4, new growth appears around months 3 to 4, density improves by months 6 to 8, and full results develop over 9 to 12 months. Results vary by case.

consultation process

qa.a: The doctor examines your hair loss pattern, donor area, scalp condition and medical history, with AI-assisted TricoScan imaging of hair density. You then learn the cause, whether you need a transplant or a treatment, and the plan and cost.

qa.a: 1. Consultation and scalp evaluation. 2. AI-driven TricoScan. 3. Diagnosis and treatment plan. 4. Hairline design. 5. Graft extraction and implantation. 6. Recovery and follow-up.

qa.q: Which hair transplant techniques do you use?
qa.v:
fue or dhi
nft technique
what is dhi
techniques offered
qa.a: FUE, DHI and the clinic's NFT implanter method, plus Unshaven U-FUE and body hair transplant. Dr. Sandeep, a DHI Global (Greece)-certified specialist, recommends the technique for your case at consultation.

qa.q: What is FUE?
qa.v:
fue meaning
follicular unit extraction
qa.a: FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction) removes hair roots one by one from the donor area, usually the back and sides of the scalp, and implants them into thinning areas. It leaves no long linear scar.

qa.q: Is it a same-day procedure?
qa.v:
day care
go home same day
hospital stay
qa.a: Yes. It is a day-care procedure and most patients go home the same day with aftercare instructions.

qa.q: How long does the surgery take?
qa.v:
surgery duration
how many hours
qa.a: A standard FUE procedure takes several hours, depending on the graft count. Larger sessions may take most of the day.

qa.q: When can I go back to work?
qa.v:
rest after transplant
office after surgery
downtime
qa.a: For desk work, many patients take 2 to 4 days; some prefer a week. Jobs with dust, sweating, helmets or heavy lifting may need more rest. The doctor will guide you.

qa.q: What is PRP?
qa.v:
prp treatment
platelet rich plasma
qa.a: PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) is a non-surgical treatment that uses your own platelet-rich plasma to support weak follicles in early thinning and hair fall. Each session takes under an hour. Neo Follicle Hair Transplant has completed 100,000+ PRP sessions.

qa.q: What is GFC?
qa.v:
gfc treatment
growth factor concentrate
qa.a: GFC (Growth Factor Concentrate) is prepared from your own blood, with growth factors concentrated, to strengthen roots and improve hair thickness. It is non-surgical with no downtime.

qa.q: How many GFC sessions are needed?
qa.v: gfc sessions
qa.a: Most patients need 3 to 4 sessions, 3 to 4 weeks apart. Your doctor sets the exact plan at consultation.

qa.q: What is QR678?
qa.v:
qr678 treatment
neo qr678
qa.a: QR678 is a non-surgical, peptide-based injectable treatment for hair fall and thinning, given over planned sessions. No blood draw is needed.

qa.q: How many QR678 sessions are needed?
qa.v: qr678 sessions
qa.a: Most patients need around 6 to 8 sessions, 2 to 3 weeks apart. Your doctor sets the exact plan at consultation.

qa.q: What is exosome therapy?
qa.v:
exosome treatment
exosomes for hair
qa.a: Exosome therapy is an advanced, non-surgical regenerative treatment for thinning hair. Exosomes come pre-formulated, so no blood draw is needed. It is planned under dermatologist supervision.

qa.q: How many exosome sessions are needed?
qa.v: exosome sessions
qa.a: Most people need 1 to 3 sessions, 3 to 4 weeks apart. Your doctor sets the exact plan at consultation.

qa.q: What is Dutexome?
qa.v: dutexome treatment
qa.a: Dutexome is a doctor-led microneedling treatment using the genuine Mesoestetic c.prof 231 Dutexome Solution, for selected patients with early to moderate thinning where follicles are still active. The session plan is set at consultation after a safety screening.

qa.q: What is stem cell hair therapy?
qa.v: stem cell treatment for hair
qa.a: Neo-Follicle Stem Cell Therapy is a non-surgical regenerative treatment for hair fall and thinning, using your own biological material, with no cuts or stitches. Most patients need 3 to 6 sessions, 3 to 4 weeks apart. Suitability is confirmed at consultation.

qa.q: What is low level laser therapy?
qa.v:
lllt
laser hair therapy
laser cap
qa.a: Low Level Laser Therapy uses low-powered red light to support hair growth, with no needles and no downtime. It is a planned course of short sessions over several months.

qa.q: What is scalp micropigmentation?
qa.v:
smp
scalp tattoo
qa.a: Scalp Micropigmentation (SMP) is a cosmetic treatment that places pigments to create the look of fuller hair or a closely shaved head. It does not regrow hair. Most people need 2 to 3 sessions, 7 to 14 days apart, and results typically last 4 to 6 years.

alopecia areata
bald patches treatment
qa.a: Yes. Alopecia, including alopecia areata, is diagnosed and treated by the dermatologist. The form of alopecia is identified first before any treatment is recommended.

qa.q: Do you treat dandruff?

dandruff treatment
itchy scalp
qa.a: Yes. Dandruff and dandruff-related hair fall are treated with a dermatologist-supervised, scalp-first plan after finding the cause.
